about: The Workbench icons of the BlockShooter drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/blockshooter.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: coloured blocks round a field, one shot in to make three greens) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/blockshooter.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. BlockShooter-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BlockShooter.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BlockShooter.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls and the licence files.
